Blinky 1.5.44

  • Cursor 的月度额度和 Grok Bot 显示时间外圈。 服务商同时报告了周期的起止时间时，在「设置 → 用量」打开「距离重置的时间」会画出时间外圈，Grok Bot 的周期只在跨度大约一周时才采用。感谢 @tyler4400 提议。
  • Antigravity 工作时圆环会显示活动标记。 agy 或 Antigravity.app 正在处理任务时，圆环里会出现转动的白色弧线，并读取这两个程序保存的对话数据库，读不到时再试一次。
  • Codex 不再倒计时提示缓存。 OpenAI 表示登录后的 Codex 会一直保留提示缓存，详细卡片和 Codex 设置页不再显示倒计时，重置卡、预测重置和最近一次重置仍留在这一页。
  • Kimi Code 会读取每月额度。 报告了每月额度的账号，会在较短的限额之后显示 Kimi Code 本月和合计本月。#112
  • Claude Code 的设置按产品显示本周用量占比。 在「设置 → 供应商 → Claude Code」的「当前用量」里，按 Anthropic 的报告列出各产品占本周用量的比例。#113
  • 内侧的第二条圆环与第一条一样粗。 在「设置 → 用量」打开「圆环内显示第二条限额」后，内侧圆环与外侧同样粗，并紧贴在内侧，相距 1 点。

在 GitHub 查看更新说明

Blinky 1.5.44

  • Cursor's monthly pools and Grok Bot get the time arc. When the provider reports both ends of the period, Time until reset under Settings → Usage draws the arc, and Grok Bot's period is used only when it spans about a week. Thanks to @tyler4400 for the suggestion.
  • Antigravity's ring shows when it is working. While agy or Antigravity.app is working, a white arc turns inside Antigravity's ring, reading the conversation databases each of them keeps and trying again when one cannot be read.
  • Codex's prompt cache countdown is gone. OpenAI says a signed-in Codex keeps its prompt cache, so the detailed card and Codex's settings pane no longer count it down, and Reset cards, Predicted reset and Last reset stay on that pane.
  • Kimi Code reads monthly allowances. An account that reports a monthly allowance shows Kimi Code's month and the combined month after the shorter limits. #112
  • Claude Code's settings show the week's split by product. Under Settings → Providers → Claude Code, Current usage lists each product's share of the week, as Anthropic reports it. #113
  • The second ring is as thick as the first. With Second limit inside the ring on under Settings → Usage, the inner ring is drawn at the same weight, 1pt inside the first.
